subject: Early engagement: expectations, support, and 30-day check-ins
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Early engagement: expectations, support, and 30-day check-ins

Ethan —

Thanks for chatting this morning. I wanted to follow up in writing to make sure we have a clear, time-bound plan to address the areas we discussed and to make sure you have the support you need. This is an early engagement note — not a formal HR process yet — but it will be tracked. High level:

What I observed
- Two recently missed delivery dates on the Core API integration (PRs merged late, missed the alpha test window).
- Several reviews with prolonged turnaround times (average review latency ~72 hrs vs team target ~36 hrs).
- Some gaps in proactively surfacing blockers; a few tasks sat unblocked for multiple days.

Immediate expectations (next 30 days)
1) Prioritize the Core API integration tasks; target: finish outstanding PRs and resolve outstanding review comments by 06/11/2027.
2) Triage daily in the #core-api channel and post a daily 1-line status update (morning).
3) Commit to 48-hour max review turnaround; if a review will exceed that, flag it with a note and assign a follow-up owner.
4) Bring blockers to our 1:1 or to me in Slack within the same business day.

Support I will provide
- Weekly focused 30-minute check-ins (already booked on calendar) to unblock and prioritize.
- Pairing sessions on Fridays for two hours to work through the most urgent PRs.
- A review of time allocation to see if a task realignment or lower-priority deferral helps.

Documentation and tracking
- I'm attaching my coaching notes and a simple 30-day checklist (support-plan-20270528.pdf). I'll also keep a brief 1:1 log (1on1-log-202704-through-202705.pdf) with agreed checkpoints.

What I need from you by EOD Monday (05/31):
- A short list (3 bullet points) of the top blockers you think are most responsible for the recent slippage.
- Confirmation that you accept the 30-day engagement and the three commitments above.

This is focused on getting you back to a steady state — we want you to succeed. If any of the expectations feel unclear or unmanageable, call me and we'll adjust. Please acknowledge receipt.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Engineering Manager, Core Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: support-plan-20270528.pdf (summary checklist, measurable checkpoints); 1on1-log-202704-through-202705.pdf (notes)

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:42:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Early engagement: expectations, support, and 30-day check-ins

Thanks for the clear note, Aditya — I appreciate the directness and the offer to pair. I accept the 30-day engagement and will work to meet the commitments. Quick notes:

Top blockers (short list)
- Context-switching across three high-priority requests from product; need help prioritizing which to pause.
- Unclear review ownership on two legacy PRs (I assumed review would come from infra).
- Local test flakiness that delayed one release candidate by ~2 days.

I’ll post the daily one-liner to #core-api starting tomorrow and will confirm which PRs I’ll focus on to hit the 06/11 target. If possible, I’d like to set the Friday pairing to 11:00–13:00 PT. I attached a short doc with personal notes on blockers.

I acknowledge receipt and will keep you posted.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Senior Software Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ethan-blockers-20270531.txt

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:07:44 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Early engagement: expectations, support, and 30-day check-ins

Monica / Lauren — forwarding the thread to ask HR to log this as an informal coaching engagement and to confirm that the documentation below is sufficient for tracking (we're not initiating a PIP). Key asks:

- Please confirm recommended language for the follow-up check-ins (I plan 06/04, 06/11, 06/25).
- Confirm whether we should route this through People Operations (formal note in Workday) or keep it as an internal manager log for now.
- If there are HR templates you prefer, send them and I’ll populate.

I’ve attached the support-plan and the previous 1:1 notes. This is intended to be remedial and supportive — I want to be clear on recordkeeping in case we need to escalate later.

Aditya

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early engagement: expectations, support, and 30-day check-ins — HR guidance and next steps

Aditya — thanks for the heads up and for the clear plan. A few notes from People Operations after reviewing your proposed cadence and the attached materials: 

1) Classification: This should be documented as an informal coaching engagement for now. We will keep a manager log in Workday (private) and a copy of the support-plan in Ethan’s HR file. No formal PIP unless goals are not met after the agreed check-ins.

2) Suggested phrasing for check-ins: stick to fact-based language and measurable checkpoints (e.g., "2 of 3 outstanding PRs closed and reviews completed by 06/11"). Avoid speculative language about intent or attitude.

3) Timeline: keep your 06/04 and 06/11 checkpoints. Add a final 30-day evaluation on 06/25 (which you already planned). If significant regressions appear before that, escalate to me immediately.

4) Documentation: Good to attach the support-plan and 1:1 log (we received both). Please also ask Ethan to provide a short confirmation email after each weekly check-in that summarizes the agreed action items — those will be filed.

5) Confidentiality & compliance: Do not include any PII beyond standard work notes. If you need to include customer-facing incidents, mask customer names.

I’ll create the private note and send a calendar placeholder for the 06/25 review so HR can join if necessary. If you want HR to join earlier check-ins, tell me which ones.

—Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
